target_customer: Web3 wallets, marketplaces, games and dApps in emerging markets needing fiat onramps
problem: Web3 apps lose users because local payment methods are not supported by fiat-to-crypto onramps, and onramp costs and failure rates are high.
business_model: SDK and aggregator with transaction fees on onramp volume
product_category: Crypto payments infrastructure, fiat onramp aggregator

founders.name: Geoffrey See
founders.background_notes: YC page: CSO of Zilliqa at a $2.4B market cap peak; World Economic Forum council member.

founders.name: Van Tran
founders.background_notes: YC page: led marketing for Netflix in Southeast Asia and Australia.

competitors.name: Onramper
competitors.what: Fiat-to-crypto onramp aggregator with a single widget and API
competitors.funding_then: $6M seed led by EQT Ventures announced 26 Jan 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart routing across multiple onramps and 100+ local payment methods with an SDK; integration heavy but not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Aggregators can be copied and depend on third party onramps; the company's local payment method coverage was the differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Wyre, a related payments platform, shut down in January 2023; no source found on others copying Poko. Status after 2023 unclear.

market_need_then: Web3 builders needed fiat onramps; the company claims up to 70% lower onramp costs and 5x higher transaction success. Demand during the 2022 to 2023 crypto downturn weakened.

branding.domain_note: Uses pokoapp.xyz, a prefixed app name on a .xyz domain.

brand_strength.rationale: A name search returned only unrelated Poko and Poki brands; the .xyz domain and name collisions weaken discoverability.

pivots.why: One profile says Poko was born after Shoppa had to pivot its business model in March 2022; single secondary source, unverified

outcome_analysis: Poko raised a $4.5M seed in June 2023 during a crypto downturn, with YC and regional investors, led by founders with Zilliqa and Netflix experience. Its aggregator sits in a crowded onramp market. Status is unclear: CB Insights reports an acquisition by Torus Labs on 13 October 2023, but the YC directory still lists it as active.
notes: Company website pokoapp.xyz returned HTTP 503. Seed round confirmed by FinTech Global, TechNode and e27 (two say YC led; one lists a broader group). Acquisition by Torus Labs (13 Oct 2023) appears only on CB Insights, which conflicts with its own alive status; recorded as exit unknown. Daniel Le is named in the YC founder Q&A as CTO of a play to earn game, not listed as a Poko founder, so excluded. No Series A found.
